questiondescription.text:
Trigonometry III: table of values for a wave

Grade 12 CBE Core 2.5: Complete a table of values for y = a sin(bx + c) or y = a cos(bx + c) in degrees, to 2 decimal places.

Core

This question is original to this project.

INNODEMS CBC Grade 12 Mathematics, first draft by Ben Davies, 2026. Aligned to the KICD Senior School Curriculum Design, Core Mathematics Grade 12 (draft).

truefeedback.text: Several values are what a calculator gives in radian mode. Switch to degrees (check that \(\sin 30 = 0.5\)).
You found the value of \({@fname@}\) but did not multiply by \({@a@}\).

falsefeedback.text: Check your values at \(x = {@wrongstr@}\). Work out the angle first: for \(x = {@xs[w1]@}^\circ\) it is \({@inner[w1]@}^\circ\). Take \({@fname@}\) of the angle in degree mode, then multiply by \({@a@}\).
